content_sections.heading: About CSIR Madras Complex
content_sections.text: CSIR Madras Complex is a campus of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research on CSIR Road, Taramani, Chennai. This recruitment is for its unit CEERI. The posts are at the CSIR-CEERI Chennai Centre in Taramani, and you can reach the office on 044-22544541, 044-22544524 or 044-22544528.

content_sections.heading: CSIR Madras Complex Project Associate-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not be older than 35 years on 12 November 2026, the date of the walk-in interview. The upper age limit is relaxed as follows: SC, ST, PwBD and female candidates: up to 5 years OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates: 3 years Essential: B.E. / B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering or Computer Science Engineering, or equivalent. Desirable: Hands-on exposure in electronic circuit/board integration. Job description: Work on developing the UVC imaging system. Essential: B.E./B.Tech. degree in CSE / ECE / E&I, or M.Sc. degree in Computer Science / Electronics, or equivalent, from a recognized University. Desirable: Knowledge of Digital Image Processing, Computer Graphics, GPU Computing, and programming in C++ and Python. Job description: Help the project team develop image processing, visualization and computational algorithms for X-ray (Computer Tomography) CT baggage scanning systems. Essential: B.E. / B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering or Computer Science Engineering, or equivalent. Desirable: Hands-on exposure in embedded systems and C coding. Job description: Work on developing the Essential Oil Quality Analyser, an embedded system. Freshers can attend the interview only if they bring at least a Provisional Certificate or a consolidated mark sheet with their results. For the full eligibility for each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview. Candidates may have to take a written test before the walk-in interview, if necessary. Candidates who arrive after 9.30 a.m. will not be allowed in. Those who come with incomplete particulars or information will also be turned away.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for six months and is likely to be extended until the project ends. The tenure follows CSIR letter No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024. Project staff are engaged on behalf of the sponsoring agency. The engagement is temporary and ends with the project or after 6 years, whichever comes first. The engagement does not give any right or claim, direct or indirect, to a permanent post in CSIR. Selected candidates will get hands-on training and exposure working on R&D projects in modern laboratories.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the CSIR Madras Complex walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 12 November 2026 at 9.30 a.m. at CSIR Madras Complex, CSIR Road, CSIR Campus, Taramani, Chennai – 600113. Late arrivals will not be allowed in.

faq.question: Q2. Can M.Sc. candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but only for Project SSP 3182 (X-ray CT baggage system). That post accepts an M.Sc. in Computer Science / Electronics. The other two posts need a B.E. / B.Tech.

faq.question: Q3. Who gets the Rs. 31,000 stipend?
faq.answer: Candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC NET or GATE get Rs. 31,000 per month plus HRA. Everyone else gets Rs. 25,000 per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. Can final-year students or freshers attend?
faq.answer: Freshers can attend only if they produce at least a Provisional Certificate or a consolidated mark sheet with their results.

faq.question: Q5. How much age relaxation is allowed?
faq.answer: SC, ST, PwBD and female candidates get up to 5 years of relaxation on the 35-year limit, and OBC (non-creamy layer) candidates get 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Candidates may have to take a written test before the walk-in interview, if necessary.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It is initially for six months and is likely to be extended until the project ends. It is temporary and ends with the project or after 6 years, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Is travel allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What skills are preferred for the essential oil project post?
faq.answer: For Project MMP025304, hands-on exposure in embedded systems and C coding is desirable. The work is on the Essential Oil Quality Analyser.
